title: Phase 6: Offline bundle and viability gate
description: Bundle the web editor for offline WebView loading, run automated gates, and perform the manual real-device editor viability checklist.
acceptance_criteria: WebView editor loads offline; mobile/editor-web builds pass where available; manual gate records cursor, keyboard, insertion, persistence, and search results; next rebuild decision is documented.

title: Phase 5: Keyboard suggestion bar and insertion
description: Add native keyboard-attached horizontal suggestions and insert tapped suggestions into the WebView cursor through Tiptap command messages.
acceptance_criteria: Suggestion bar appears while body editor is focused; suggestions scroll horizontally; repeated taps insert word + one trailing space at the visible cursor without losing focus.

title: Phase 3: Tiptap editor web bundle
description: Create the editor-web package with minimal Tiptap/ProseMirror editor and typed bridge message helpers.
acceptance_criteria: Editor runs in browser/dev mode; typing emits contentChanged; selection emits suggestion context; insertSuggestion/loadSong commands exist.
notes: Selector chose Phase 3 as the next ready child. Implementation must continue from lavender/expo-webview-rebuild-test and open the next PR against that branch. Scope: apps/editor-web Vite + TypeScript package, minimal Tiptap editor, typed bridge messages, WebView-callable loadSong/insertSuggestion/focusEditor/setTheme commands, and suggestion-context tests if practical. Do not integrate React Native WebView, native persistence bridge, offline bundling, or rhyme highlighting/decorations.

title: Phase 4: WebView bridge and body persistence
description: Load the Tiptap editor in React Native WebView, exchange typed messages, and persist bodyJson/bodyText from WebView updates.
acceptance_criteria: Editor body edits persist after navigating away/back; body text updates previews/search; bridge is typed and narrow.

title: Phase 2: Song persistence and app shell
description: Implement typed Song model, local repository, Songs screen, search, create/delete/open, and editor route with native title editing.
acceptance_criteria: Create/open/delete/search work; title edits persist; repository tests cover CRUD and title/body search.
notes:
Selector chose Phase 2 as the next ready child. Implementation must continue from lavender/expo-webview-rebuild-test and open the next PR against that branch. Scope: song model/repository, Songs screen create/open/delete/search, editor route with native title editing, debounced title persistence, and repository CRUD/search tests.
